(5)  The  Disciplinary  Committee  while  deciding,
according to Dhamma and Vinaya, on disciplinary matters
pertaining to all the members and trained and trainees of the
body corporate and decisions taken by the executive board
shall rely on Dhamma and Vinaya found in the Tripitaka,
Commentaries  (Atthakatha)  and  sub-commentaries  (Tika)
which were authenticated in six ancient Buddhist councils
(Dhamma-Sangayana)  accepted  within  the  Theravadha
tradition,  and  well  preserved  in  Burma,  Thailand,  Laos,
Cambodia  and  Sri  Lanka  and  European  countries  and
Dhamma Vinaya Books written according to the Theravadha
teachings  without  contradiciting  them  (Theravadha
teachings) and ideas of renowned erudite scholars that are
not contradicting with the Theravadha teachings.
